rationale: The digest shows a massive +216.8% spike in currencyservice memory (z=+43.35) and a +103.7% increase in socket connections, indicating severe memory pressure or a leak. This directly correlates with the ~8-second latency and frontend errors in the traces routing through currencyservice.

proposed_fix.description: Restart currencyservice pods to clear memory pressure and reset connection pools.
